name: IKleeneAlgebra
doc: Kleene algebra — a star-SEMIRING: ISemiring (Zero/One/Add/Mul) plus the iteration operator Star (Kleene closure), Star(a) = One ⊕ a ⊕ (a⊗a) ⊕ …, the least fixpoint of x = One ⊕ (a⊗x). This is the KLEENE star (reflexive-transitive closure), NOT the involution star (Conj) of IStarRing — orthogonal branches. Kleene addition is idempotent (min-plus tropical, booleans, regular-language union), so there is NO additive inverse: this extends ISemiring, never IRing (081KWG9JQ9H). The matrix star over a Kleene algebra computes the all-pairs closure — tropical→shortest paths, boolean→transitive closure (Lehmann 1977; Kozen 1994). Mirrored from src/Core.Abstractions/IKleeneAlgebra.cs and its F# instances (NovelMath TropicalSemiring, KleeneClosure BooleanKleene).

members.name: Add
members.doc: Additive combination (⊕) — idempotent in a Kleene algebra (a ⊕ a = a).

members.name: Star
members.doc: Kleene closure (iteration): Star(a) = One ⊕ (a ⊗ Star(a)) = One ⊕ (Star(a) ⊗ a), the least fixpoint of x = One ⊕ (a⊗x). Tropical (min,+) with non-negative weights ⇒ Star(a)=One (0): a self-loop never improves a shortest path.

laws.doc: Add(Add(a,b),c) = Add(a,Add(b,c)) — a semiring axiom, holds in every Kleene algebra.

laws.proof: tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/KleeneClosure.Tests.fs:BooleanKleene is a lawful Kleene algebra (∨/∧, star = true)
laws.doc: Add(a, a) = a — the DISTINGUISHING Kleene axiom (idempotent addition). Documented, NOT scalar-cross-verified: it does NOT hold over native +/* arithmetic (only for 0), so the scalar harness must skip it; it holds in the idempotent carriers (boolean ∨, tropical min). Proven in F# on the concrete instances.

laws.proof: tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/KleeneClosure.Tests.fs:BooleanKleene is a lawful Kleene algebra (∨/∧, star = true)
laws.doc: Star(a) = One ⊕ (a ⊗ Star(a)). Documented (star has no finite scalar encoding — over reals it diverges); proven in F# on BooleanKleene and the tropical instance.

laws.proof: tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/KleeneClosure.Tests.fs:BooleanKleene is a lawful Kleene algebra (∨/∧, star = true)
laws.doc: Star(a) = One ⊕ (Star(a) ⊗ a). Documented; proven in F#.

laws.proof: tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/KleeneClosure.Tests.fs:LAW: reachability closure = the naive reachable-set (BFS) on random DAGs+cycles
laws.doc: The matrix star over a Kleene algebra computes the all-pairs reflexive-transitive closure — boolean ⇒ reachability (= BFS), tropical ⇒ all-pairs shortest paths (Lehmann 1977). Documented (a matrix/graph-level law); proven in F# against a naive BFS oracle.
